nodes.name: 03:00 ET nightly
nodes.notes: Runs at 03:00 America/New_York. The Python job stops itself at 03:55 ET so it never overlaps the cockpit refresh at 04:06.

nodes.name: Pull cockpit repo

parameters.command:
set -e
cd /home/node/.n8n-files/intakeq
[ -d cockpit ] || git clone --depth 1 "$COCKPIT_REPO_URL" cockpit
cd cockpit && git pull --ff-only
[ -d ../ledger-tool ] || git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/timboj55/first_one ../ledger-tool
cd ../ledger-tool && git pull --ff-only

nodes.notes: Requires git + python3 on the n8n host and env vars COCKPIT_REPO_URL (with a deploy token) and INTAKEQ_API_KEY set on the n8n container. Never put either in the workflow JSON.

nodes.name: Run nightly reconciliation

parameters.command:
set -e
cd /home/node/.n8n-files/intakeq/ledger-tool
python3 -m intakeq_packages nightly \
  --config packages.json \
  --appt-map ../cockpit/data/appt_packages.json \
  --export ../cockpit/data/packages_all.csv \
  --out ../cockpit/data \
  --pace 8 --max-calls 300

nodes.notes: Writes data/packages_ledger.csv, data/packages_ledger_derived.csv, data/nightly_state.json and updates data/appt_packages.json in the cockpit checkout. Paced at 7.5 req/min, hard stop 03:55 ET, leftovers carried to the next night.

nodes.name: Commit ledger to cockpit

parameters.command:
set -e
cd /home/node/.n8n-files/intakeq/cockpit
git add data/packages_ledger.csv data/packages_ledger_derived.csv data/appt_packages.json data/nightly_state.json
if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo 'no changes'; exit 0; fi
git -c user.name='intakeq-ledger-bot' -c user.email='ledger-bot@movementsolutions-sc.com' commit -q -m "Nightly IntakeQ package ledger $(date -u +%F)"
git push

nodes.notes: Commits only when files changed. The cockpit compares data/packages_ledger.csv with data/packages_all.csv before adopting it.

nodes.name: Summarize
nodes.notes: Attach your preferred alerting node here (email/Slack) for the error branch and for reports with carried_over_ids > 0.
